text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, as usual, while I was working in 
the Trainer's Office...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …………U-Um, you see... Well... err.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother, do you like chocolate? Would 
you be happy to get some?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Do you like chocolate, Big Sister? Would 
you be happy if you got some?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing the word "chocolate" reminds me. 
...Come to think of it, today is 
Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so! Ehehe, in that case...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Rice Shower ran off into the 
distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After a little while—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUMP!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...On top of the desk was a mountain of 
chocolates brought in by Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I made plenty of varieties. Sweet ones, 
bitter ones, some with nuts, and some with 
strawberries.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —So choose, dear brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —So choose, dear sister!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I mean, nobody wants to eat food 
they hate, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why I made a whole bunch. ...I 
thought maybe you'd like at least one of 
the flavors.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Rice Shower made several 
different kinds of handmade chocolates to 
suit my tastes.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh... What's wrong? Did they not have 
the chocolate you like?
choice_data_list: Is it okay if I take all of them?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fwaaah!? I'm gonna be completely stuffed!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Are you truly... alright...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower stared back at me with a 
worried look...
choice_data_list: Help me out if it comes down to it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Rice can eat a lot. So if you 
reach your limit, tell me right away, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I'm so glad I made chocolates...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And under Rice Shower's watchful gaze, I 
ate the first piece of chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower stared back at me with a 
worried look...
choice_data_list:
Because I want to accept all of Rice 
Shower's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. You really didn't have to...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Still... maybe I should have made more, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Just this isn't enough to show how much 
I feel for you, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Just this isn't enough to show how 
much I appreciate you, Big Sis."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I spent a sweet Valentine's Day 
with Rice Shower.
